scientific_question: Can the frozen F7 entity-identity representation and F5 learned recurrent composer distinguish queries about exactly k-1 versus k hops when graph, query endpoints and all entity IDs are identical and only requested length differs?
hypothesis: Current frozen model lacks an explicit requested-depth input and uses exactly 3 recurrent message passes. It must return the same prediction for both requests, failing paired contrast despite prior four-hop accuracy.

cohort.baseline_and_intervention: Same graph and endpoint pair, exact requested depth only changes k-1 to k; additional graph edges disconnected distractors
controls: fully coded exact-depth reachability must score 96/96 pairs
cohort.invariance: No requested-depth input exists in frozen candidate; no rerunning F9 or threshold tuning

next_design: Separate future preregistration should add a genuine conditioning signal and learn variable-depth recursion, with length 8+ capacity/halting/resource controls; NOT a retrofit of frozen F3 or F10.
